mapper.sql: RESOURCE_ID, RESOURCE_URL, RESOURCE_METHOD, MENU_NAME, MENU_ICON_URL, MENU_RANK_NO, ISMENU, MENU_ENDFLAG, PARENT_RESOURCE_ID, STATUS, SYS_CODE, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, REMARK
mapper.select: SELECT r.RESOURCE_ID, r.RESOURCE_URL, r.RESOURCE_METHOD, r.MENU_NAME, r.MENU_ICON_URL, r.MENU_RANK_NO, r.ISMENU, r.MENU_ENDFLAG, r.PARENT_RESOURCE_ID, r.STATUS, r.SYS_CODE, r.CREATE_TIME, r.CREATE_USER, r.UPDATE_TIME, r.UPDATE_USER, r.REMARK FROM PT_RESOURCE r INNER JOIN PT_ROLE_RESOURCE rr ON r.RESOURCE_ID = rr.RESOURCE_ID WHERE rr.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} ORDER BY r.MENU_RANK_NO ASC
